in_sanskrit.name: गगन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: that which goes or moves in the sky, i.e., the sky itself, the heavens, or the clouds

in_hindi.name: गगन
in_hindi.long_meaning: that which goes or moves in the sky, i.e., the sky itself, the heavens, or the clouds

in_tamil.name: ககனம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: that which is above and beyond, i.e., the sky, the heavens, or the universe

in_telugu.name: గగన
in_telugu.long_meaning: that which is beyond or above the earth

in_marathi.name: Gagan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sky, heaven, universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gagan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘gam’, meaning ‘to go’, Gagan signifies the vast expanse of the sky or the heavens. In Hindu mythology, the celestial bodies are believed to move in the Gagan Lok, or the heavenly realm. The term is also used to describe the universe as a whole, suggesting boundless freedom and infinite possibilities.
